BiblicalUsage: Adikos is the adverb 'unjustly' or 'wrongfully,' and it appears only once: when a servant endures grief, 'suffering wrongfully,' for conscience toward God. Peter is talking about the person who is punished for doing nothing wrong, and who bears it patiently because God sees.
TheologicalSignificance: Its job is finished inside its sentence; the theology, if there is any to find, belongs to the passage as a whole; in this case, the verse is 1 Peter 2:19.
